subject: [NAME] - legal AI ground truth
text:
Hi 
      [NAME], 

      Big fan of [COMPANY]'s approach to legal AI!

      As you scale, finding and labeling high-quality, domain-specific data often becomes the primary constraints on model performance. We specialize in building custom curation, annotation, and model eval pipelines that teams like Appfolio, Reducto and UiPath use to establish ground truth and maintain model accuracy. 

      Curious to learn how you're thinking about your data flywheel at [COMPANY] - open to a quick chat next week?

subject: Is your 3D data pipeline slowing model development?
text:
Hi [NAME],

I've noticed that many of the to ML teams I speak to in the physical AI space find 3D cuboid labeling to be a big bottleneck in their pipeline.

As point cloud datasets grow, drawing cuboids frame by frame turns into a slow, expensive grind and it's hard to scale.

So we're hosting a short, 20-minute masterclass on the 19th of Feb to walk through how teams are moving away from manual-first 3D annotation and into autolabeling workflows, where models generate cuboids and humans focus on review, fixes, and edge cases.

You can save your spot here: [LINK] Or, if you can't make it live, sign up: [LINK] anyway and we'll send you the recording.

subject: Thoughts for [COMPANY]
text:
Hi [NAME],

Impressive work on the 30B-parameter contact centre LLM and VoiceAI Agents.

A common bottleneck we hear from teams training at this scale: data quality

Encord helps AI teams curate and annotate training data at scale with

Open to connecting next week to see if we could help?

subject: Thoughts for [COMPANY]
text:
Hi [NAME],

I've been following [COMPANY]'s work in fraud detection and know that keeping
false-positive rates low while staying ahead of new fraud patterns is a
constant challenge.

We built Encord to help with exactly that. Our ML Ops platform gives IDV
and fraud prevention teams better tools for data curation, which translates
directly into higher model accuracy and faster iteration.

Would you be open to a brief call next week to explore if there's a fit?

subject: Cutting through fraud pattern noise at SEON
text:
Hi [NAME],

Given SEON's real-time fraud detection approach, I imagine keeping your
models accurate as fraud patterns evolve is a constant challenge -
especially when the underlying data is messy or slow to curate.

We built Encord to solve exactly that. Fraud teams use our platform to cut
the time spent on data curation while improving model accuracy and
visibility into emerging threat patterns - without the maintenance burden
of in-house tooling.

Would you be open to connecting early next week to see if Encord is a good
fit for SEON?

subject: Scalpel Ltd.'s AI Pipeline
text:
[NAME], 

There's a pattern we keep seeing with ML teams at your stage: engineers burning sprint cycles on a pipeline stage that isn't the actual constraint. 

Labeling is usually the first thing to get attention; it's measurable, the team can point to output, and it's easy to staff up. But when we map the pipeline, the real throughput bottleneck is in curation or validation far more often than anyone expects. Model performance doesn't move. Nobody can explain why. 

We built a diagnostic that identifies which stage it actually is for your setup; maps across curation, labeling, QA, and validation, and generates a fix-priority report. 

If that's useful, I'll send it over.
